newsitem.title: BRAZIL: SOCCER-EDMUNDO SCORES HAT-TRICK AS FLAMENGO ROUTED.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-EDMUNDO SCORES HAT-TRICK AS FLAMENGO ROUTED.

text.p: Striker Edmundo scored a hat-trick against his old team as Vasco da Gama handed Flamengo their second 4-1 defeat in five days at the weekend.
Edmundo took seven minutes to make his mark, chipping the ball over goalkeeper Ze Carlos, and then converted a penalty in the 32nd minute.
He completed his hat-trick midway through the second half, breaking clear of the Flamengo defence and slotting the ball into the far corner. Macedo scored Vasco's other goal early in the second half.

Flamengo striker Bebeto, who played for both clubs before a four-year spell in Spain, missed a penalty with the score at 2-0 but converted another one nine minutes from the end to give his team a late consolation.
It was not enough to stop Flamengo fans chanting the name of Romario, the Brazilian World Cup hero who left the club shortly after Bebeto's arrival.

In the same fixture last year Edmundo, playing for Flamengo, made an obsence gesture at Vasco fans and was subsequently banned for 40 days. He rejoined Vasco, the club where he began his career, after six months with Corinthians.
The result lifted Vasco into seventh place in the competition in which the top eight clubs progress to the quarter-finals.
Cruzeiro went top of the championship with a 2-1 win at home to Gremio after leaders' Palmeiras saw their Sao Paulo derby with Corinthians washed out by torrential rain.
Bottom club Bragantino won for the first time in 12 attempts, beating Parana at home in front of only 458 fans.
